exposure: moderate/severe HIE receiving 72 hours of hypothermia
moderate/severe HIE receiving 48 hours of hypothermia
outcome: Mental and Psychomotor Development Indices scores
cohort: 92 neonatal patients with moderate/severe hypoxic-ischemic encephalopathy (HIE) and 30 healthy controls
finding: The study found that 72 hours of hypothermia treatment was more effective than 48 hours in improving oxidative conditions, reducing NSE values, and improving neurological behavior and development in neonates with moderate/severe HIE.
